marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southeast 20 knots near noon
Saturday. Periods of snow this evening Saturday afternoon and
evening. Visibility as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>
